title: LCRA HLWO Utility Permit
permit_name: Highland Lakes Watershed Ordinance General Utility Permit

source_citations.reference: HLWO Technical Manual and Construction Standard Details

permits.name: Highland Lakes Watershed Ordinance General Utility Permit

explanations.trigger_explanation: Utility construction within the Lower Colorado River Authority Highland Lakes Watershed Ordinance jurisdiction commonly requires notification and can require the ordinance's general utility permit.

known_unknowns: The Lower Colorado River Authority requires notification before work begins, and permit necessity depends on ordinance thresholds and jurisdictional location.
advisories: Additional review recommended to verify the site is inside the watershed ordinance jurisdiction and whether separate dredge and fill or stormwater reviews also apply.
notes: Confidence tier 2 because the Lower Colorado River Authority directly publishes the ordinance program, but project-level permit need depends on jurisdictional mapping and ordinance thresholds.
